sessions.notes: Sample practice (simulated). Most 6v6 rallies ended on the serve or the first pass. In Monarch, pairs got far more touches, and the full-depth rule kicked in quickly on the stronger court.
Sample practice (simulated). Tips and roll shots started to show up once the short and deep zones scored 2. The lead-by-3 rule kept lane games within a few points.
Sample practice (simulated). Observers called "Base" most often. Covering the hitter improved in the second game.
Sample practice (simulated). Smaller group today. Free balls gave every triple a three-contact chance; the trailing team used catch-and-set and games stayed close.
Sample practice (simulated). Announcing the block helped the trailing team read the open space. Block points were rare but noticed.
Sample practice (simulated). Wash games ran long; the down-ball rule stopped one team running away. End-of-unit 6v6 count is below.
